+"""SQLite storage (prototype; PostgreSQL is the scale target). Raw values are immutable (trigger)."""
+import json
+import sqlite3
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+
+SCHEMA = """
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stations(
+  station_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, latitude REAL, longitude REAL, altitude_m REAL, source TEXT);
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS observations(
+  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, station_id TEXT NOT NULL, observation_time TEXT NOT NULL, ingestion_time TEXT NOT NULL,
+  temperature_c REAL, pressure_hpa REAL, relative_humidity_pct REAL, source TEXT,
+  delayed INTEGER, out_of_order INTEGER, lag_minutes REAL, processing_latency_ms REAL, detector_mode TEXT,
+  is_anomaly INTEGER, anomaly_probability REAL, anomaly_score REAL, fault_pattern TEXT, parameter TEXT,
+  severity TEXT, severity_score REAL, regional_evidence INTEGER, regional_suppressed INTEGER,
+  weather_status TEXT, regional_score REAL,
+  health_score REAL, health_status TEXT,
+  estimated_temperature_c REAL, estimated_pressure_hpa REAL, estimated_relative_humidity_pct REAL,
+  replacement_recommended INTEGER, edge_flags TEXT, edge_health_score REAL,
+  UNIQUE(station_id, observation_time));
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS obs_station_time ON observations(station_id, observation_time);
+CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS raw_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF
+  station_id, observation_time, temperature_c, pressure_hpa, relative_humidity_pct ON observations
+BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'raw observations are immutable'); END;
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS anomalies(
+  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, observation_id INTEGER, station_id TEXT NOT NULL, observation_time TEXT NOT NULL,
+  detected_at TEXT NOT NULL, parameter TEXT, fault_pattern TEXT NOT NULL, severity TEXT,
+  anomaly_probability REAL, anomaly_score REAL, raw_value REAL, estimated_value REAL,
+  regional_evidence INTEGER, explanation TEXT, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN', detector_mode TEXT);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS anom_station ON anomalies(station_id, observation_time);
+"""
+
+OBS_COLS = ["station_id", "observation_time", "ingestion_time", "temperature_c", "pressure_hpa", "relative_humidity_pct",
+            "source", "delayed", "out_of_order", "lag_minutes", "processing_latency_ms", "detector_mode", "is_anomaly",
+            "anomaly_probability", "anomaly_score", "fault_pattern", "parameter", "severity", "severity_score",
+            "regional_evidence", "regional_suppressed", "weather_status", "regional_score", "health_score", "health_status", "estimated_temperature_c",
+            "estimated_pressure_hpa", "estimated_relative_humidity_pct", "replacement_recommended", "edge_flags",
+            "edge_health_score"]
+
+
+class DB:
+    def __init__(self, path: str):
+        Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        self.path = path
+        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(path, check_same_thread=False)
+        self.conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
+        self.conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
+        self.conn.executescript(SCHEMA)
+        for col in ("weather_status TEXT", "regional_score REAL"):  # migrate databases created before these columns
+            try:
+                self.conn.execute(f"ALTER TABLE observations ADD COLUMN {col}")
+            except sqlite3.OperationalError:
+                pass
+        self.lock = threading.Lock()
+
+    def reset(self) -> None:
+        with self.lock:
+            self.conn.executescript("DELETE FROM anomalies; DELETE FROM observations;")
+            self.conn.commit()
+
+    def upsert_stations(self, stations: dict) -> None:
+        with self.lock:
+            self.conn.executemany(
+                "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO stations VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)",
+                [(s, m.get("latitude"), m.get("longitude"), m.get("altitude_m"), m.get("source")) for s, m in stations.items()])
+            self.conn.commit()
+
+    def insert_result(self, r: dict, source: str | None) -> int | None:
+        """Insert one processed observation (+ anomaly rows). Returns observation id, None if duplicate."""
+        vals = {**r, "source": source, "edge_flags": json.dumps(r.get("edge_flags")) if r.get("edge_flags") is not None else None}
+        with self.lock:
+            cur = self.conn.execute(
+                f"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO observations ({','.join(OBS_COLS)}) VALUES ({','.join('?' * len(OBS_COLS))})",
+                [vals.get(c) for c in OBS_COLS])
+            if cur.rowcount == 0:
+                self.conn.commit()
+                return None
+            oid = cur.lastrowid
+            if r.get("is_anomaly"):
+                p = r.get("parameter") or ""
+                raw = r.get(p) if p in ("temperature_c", "pressure_hpa", "relative_humidity_pct") else None
+                est = r.get(f"estimated_{p}") if raw is not None else None
+                self._anomaly(oid, r, r["fault_pattern"], r.get("severity"), raw, est, r.get("explanation"), "OPEN")
+            if r.get("regional_suppressed"):
+                self._anomaly(oid, r, "REGIONAL_WEATHER_EVENT", None, None, None, r.get("explanation"), "INFO")
+            if r.get("gap_event"):
+                g = r["gap_event"]
+                self._anomaly(None, {**r, "observation_time": g["start"], "parameter": "all", "anomaly_probability": None,
+                                     "anomaly_score": None}, "MISSING_COMMUNICATION", "MEDIUM", None, None,
+                              {"status": "ANOMALY DETECTED", "likely_fault_pattern": "Likely fault pattern: missing data / communication gap",
+                               "evidence": [g["explanation"]], "pattern": "MISSING_COMMUNICATION", "parameter": "all",
+                               "detector_mode": "deterministic_qc", "note": "Observable data pattern, not a confirmed physical hardware diagnosis."}, "OPEN")
+            self.conn.commit()
+            return oid
+
+    def apply_revision(self, rv: dict) -> None:
+        """Apply a re-scored (provisional -> revised) result. Only result columns change; raw values are immutable."""
+        cols = ["is_anomaly", "anomaly_probability", "anomaly_score", "fault_pattern", "parameter", "severity", "severity_score",
+                "regional_evidence", "regional_suppressed", "weather_status", "regional_score", "estimated_temperature_c", "estimated_pressure_hpa",
+                "estimated_relative_humidity_pct", "replacement_recommended"]
+        key = (rv["station_id"], rv["observation_time"])
+        with self.lock:
+            cur = self.conn.execute(f"UPDATE observations SET {', '.join(c + '=?' for c in cols)} WHERE station_id=? AND observation_time=?",
+                                    [rv.get(c) for c in cols] + list(key))
+            if cur.rowcount == 0:
+                self.conn.commit()
+                return
+            oid = self.conn.execute("SELECT id, ingestion_time FROM observations WHERE station_id=? AND observation_time=?", key).fetchone()
+            live = "station_id=? AND observation_time=? AND observation_id IS NOT NULL AND state IN ('OPEN','ACKNOWLEDGED')"
+            p = rv.get("parameter") or ""
+            raw = rv["raw"].get(p) if p in rv["raw"] else None
+            est = rv.get(f"estimated_{p}") if raw is not None else None
+            if rv["was_anomaly"] and not rv["is_anomaly"]:
+                note = {"status": "RETRACTED", "evidence": [f"Provisional alert retracted: {rv['reason']}."] +
+                        ((rv.get("explanation") or {}).get("evidence") or []), "note": "Revised with complete spatial context."}
+                self.conn.execute(f"UPDATE anomalies SET state='RETRACTED', explanation=? WHERE {live}", (json.dumps(note), *key))
+            elif rv["is_anomaly"] and self.conn.execute(f"UPDATE anomalies SET fault_pattern=?, parameter=?, severity=?, anomaly_probability=?, "
+                                                        f"anomaly_score=?, raw_value=?, estimated_value=?, regional_evidence=?, explanation=? WHERE {live}",
+                                                        (rv["fault_pattern"], p, rv["severity"], rv["anomaly_probability"], rv["anomaly_score"], raw, est,
+                                                         int(rv["regional_evidence"]), json.dumps(rv.get("explanation")), *key)).rowcount == 0:
+                self._anomaly(oid["id"], {**rv, "ingestion_time": oid["ingestion_time"]}, rv["fault_pattern"], rv["severity"], raw, est,
+                              rv.get("explanation"), "OPEN")
+            if rv.get("regional_suppressed"):
+                self._anomaly(oid["id"], {**rv, "ingestion_time": oid["ingestion_time"]}, "REGIONAL_WEATHER_EVENT", None, None, None,
+                              rv.get("explanation"), "INFO")
+            self.conn.commit()
+
+    def _anomaly(self, oid, r, pattern, sev, raw, est, exp, state):
+        self.conn.execute(
+            "INSERT INTO anomalies (observation_id, station_id, observation_time, detected_at, parameter, fault_pattern, severity,"
+            " anomaly_probability, anomaly_score, raw_value, estimated_value, regional_evidence, explanation, state, detector_mode)"
+            " VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
+            (oid, r["station_id"], r["observation_time"], r["ingestion_time"], r.get("parameter"), pattern, sev,
+             r.get("anomaly_probability"), r.get("anomaly_score"), raw, est, int(bool(r.get("regional_evidence"))),
+             json.dumps(exp) if exp is not None else None, state, r.get("detector_mode")))
+
+    def query(self, sql: str, args: tuple = ()) -> list[dict]:
+        with self.lock:
+            return [dict(x) for x in self.conn.execute(sql, args).fetchall()]
+
+    def execute(self, sql: str, args: tuple = ()) -> int:
+        with self.lock:
+            cur = self.conn.execute(sql, args)
+            self.conn.commit()
+            return cur.rowcount"},{"sha":"f0ad8fd6be2b0c64179bb1d454fa3d80ebbdb894","filename":"backend/replay.py","status":"added","additions":132,"deletions":0,"changes":132,"blob_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/blob/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/backend%2Freplay.py","raw_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/raw/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/backend%2Freplay.py","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/contents/backend%2Freplay.py?ref=268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,132 @@
+"""Deterministic replay of a scenario CSV through per-station StationClients (store-and-forward).
+
+Scenario files live in data/demo/<name>.csv (only names matching [a-z0-9_] are accepted; no
+arbitrary paths). Columns: timestamp, station_id, temperature_c, pressure_hpa,
+relative_humidity_pct, phase ('warmup'|'live'), link_up (1/0), note.
+Warm-up rows are delivered immediately; live rows are paced by observation time / speed.
+"""
+import re
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pandas as pd
+
+from edge.station_client import StationClient
+from ml.config import ROOT
+
+try:
+    from edge.edge_checks import EdgeChecker
+    EdgeChecker()
+    EDGE_AVAILABLE = True
+except (FileNotFoundError, OSError):
+    EDGE_AVAILABLE = False
+
+
+def load_scenario(path: Path) -> pd.DataFrame:
+    df = pd.read_csv(path)
+    df["timestamp"] = pd.to_datetime(df["timestamp"], utc=True)
+    for c, d in (("phase", "live"), ("link_up", 1), ("note", "")):
+        if c not in df:
+            df[c] = d
+    df["note"] = df["note"].fillna("")
+    return df.sort_values(["timestamp", "station_id"], kind="stable").reset_index(drop=True)
+
+
+class ReplayRunner:
+    def __init__(self, state, demo_dir: Path | None = None):
+        self.S = state
+        self.dir = Path(demo_dir or ROOT / "data" / "demo")
+        self.thread: threading.Thread | None = None
+        self.stop_ev = threading.Event()
+        self._status = {"running": False, "scenario": None}
+
+    def scenarios(self) -> list[str]:
+        return sorted(p.stem for p in self.dir.glob("*.csv")
+                      if re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9_]{1,64}", p.stem) and not p.stem.endswith("_truth"))  # truth = answer key
+
+    def status(self) -> dict:
+        return dict(self._status)
+
+    def start(self, name: str, speed: float, reset: bool) -> dict:
+        self.stop()
+        if reset:
+            self.S.reset()
+        df = load_scenario(self.dir / f"{name}.csv")
+        self.stop_ev.clear()
+        self._status = {"running": True, "scenario": name, "speed": speed, "phase": "starting", "progress": 0.0,
+                        "rows": int(len(df)), "stream_time": None, "edge": "C library via ctypes" if EDGE_AVAILABLE else "not built",
+                        "links": {}, "buffered": {}, "note": ""}
+        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run, args=(df, speed), daemon=True)
+        self.thread.start()
+        return self.status()
+
+    def stop(self) -> dict:
+        self.stop_ev.set()
+        if self.thread and self.thread.is_alive():
+            self.thread.join(timeout=10)
+        self._status["running"] = False
+        return self.status()
+
+    def _run(self, df: pd.DataFrame, speed: float) -> None:
+        S = self.S
+        try:
+            warm = df[df["phase"] == "warmup"]
+            live = df[df["phase"] != "warmup"]
+            self._status["phase"] = "warmup"
+            S.publish("replay", self._status)
+            n_warm = max(1, warm["station_id"].nunique())
+            for k, (sid, g) in enumerate(warm.groupby("station_id")):
+                recs = [_obs(r) for r in g.itertuples()]
+                for i in range(0, len(recs), 200):
+                    if self.stop_ev.is_set():
+                        return
+                    S.ingest(recs[i:i + 200], quiet=True)
+                self._status["progress"] = round(0.5 * (k + 1) / n_warm, 3)
+                S.publish("replay", self._status)
+            edge = {}
+            clients = {}
+            for sid in live["station_id"].unique():
+                edge[sid] = EdgeChecker() if EDGE_AVAILABLE else None
+                clients[sid] = StationClient(sid, send=lambda batch: S.ingest(batch), edge=edge[sid])
+            self._status["phase"] = "live"
+            prev = None
+            n = len(live)
+            for i, (ts, tick) in enumerate(live.groupby("timestamp", sort=True)):
+                if prev is not None:
+                    wait = (ts - prev).total_seconds() / speed
+                    if self.stop_ev.wait(wait):
+                        return
+                prev = ts
+                for r in tick.itertuples():
+                    c = clients[r.station_id]
+                    up = bool(r.link_up)
+                    if up != c.online:
+                        S.publish("link", {"station_id": r.station_id, "online": up, "buffered": len(c.buffer),
+                                           "stream_time": ts.isoformat()})
+                        c.set_link(up)
+                    c.observe(_obs(r))
+                    if r.note:
+                        self._status["note"] = r.note
+                self._status.update(progress=round(0.5 + 0.5 * tick.index[-1] / max(n, 1) if n else 1.0, 3),
+                                    stream_time=ts.isoformat(),
+                                    links={s: c.online for s, c in clients.items()},
+                                    buffered={s: len(c.buffer) for s, c in clients.items()})
+                S.publish("replay", self._status)
+            for c in clients.values():  # end of scenario: every station reconnects and syncs
+                c.set_link(True)
+            self._status.update(buffered={s: len(c.buffer) for s, c in clients.items()},
+                                client_stats={s: c.stats for s, c in clients.items()})
+        except Exception as e:  # surface failures instead of dying silently
+            self._status["error"] = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
+            raise
+        finally:
+            self._status["running"] = False
+            self._status["phase"] = "finished" if not self.stop_ev.is_set() else "stopped"
+            S.publish("replay", self._status)
+
+
+def _obs(r) -> dict:
+    def f(x):
+        return None if pd.isna(x) else float(x)
+    return {"station_id": r.station_id, "timestamp": r.timestamp.isoformat(), "temperature_c": f(r.temperature_c),
+            "pressure_hpa": f(r.pressure_hpa), "relative_humidity_pct": f(r.relative_humidity_pct), "source": "replay"}"},{"sha":"078ef47bff0ab9435f4d75ecf6afcde8eb01f53d","filename":"backend/schemas.py","status":"added","additions":146,"deletions":0,"changes":146,"blob_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/blob/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/backend%2Fschemas.py","raw_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/raw/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/backend%2Fschemas.py","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/contents/backend%2Fschemas.py?ref=268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,146 @@
+"""Typed API payloads."""
+import math
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from typing import Annotated, Any
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, field_validator
+
+StationId = Annotated[str, Field(pattern=r"^[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{1,32}$")]
+Measurement = Annotated[float | None, Field(default=None, ge=-1e6, le=1e6)]
+
+
+class ObservationIn(BaseModel):
+    """One AWS observation. A missing parameter is allowed (it is flagged by QC, not rejected);
+    malformed values (non-numeric, NaN/inf) are rejected with 422."""
+    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
+    station_id: StationId
+    timestamp: datetime = Field(description="observation time (ISO 8601; naive = UTC)")
+    temperature_c: Measurement = None
+    pressure_hpa: Measurement = None
+    relative_humidity_pct: Measurement = None
+    source: Annotated[str | None, Field(max_length=64)] = None
+    edge_flags: Annotated[list[Annotated[str, Field(max_length=32)]] | None, Field(max_length=16)] = None
+    edge_health_score: Annotated[float | None, Field(ge=0, le=100)] = None
+
+    @field_validator("temperature_c", "pressure_hpa", "relative_humidity_pct")
+    @classmethod
+    def finite(cls, v):
+        if v is not None and not math.isfinite(v):
+            raise ValueError("must be a finite number or null")
+        return v
+
+    @field_validator("timestamp")
+    @classmethod
+    def utc(cls, v: datetime):
+        return v.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) if v.tzinfo is None else v.astimezone(timezone.utc)
+
+
+class BatchIn(BaseModel):
+    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
+    observations: Annotated[list[ObservationIn], Field(min_length=1, max_length=5000)]
+
+
+class ObservationResult(BaseModel):
+    station_id: str
+    observation_time: str
+    ingestion_time: str
+    status: str
+    reason: str | None = None
+    temperature_c: float | None = None
+    pressure_hpa: float | None = None
+    relative_humidity_pct: float | None = None
+    delayed: bool | None = None
+    lag_minutes: float | None = None
+    lag_reference: str | None = None
+    out_of_order: bool | None = None
+    detector_mode: str | None = None
+    is_anomaly: bool | None = None
+    anomaly_probability: float | None = Field(None, description="isotonic-calibrated P(anomaly); null in qc_only_fallback")
+    anomaly_score: float | None = Field(None, description="uncalibrated detector output (not a probability)")
+    fault_pattern: str | None = None
+    parameter: str | None = None
+    severity: str | None = None
+    severity_score: float | None = None
+    regional_evidence: bool | None = None
+    regional_suppressed: bool | None = None
+    weather_status: str | None = Field(None, description="NORMAL | REGIONAL_WEATHER | REGIONAL_WEATHER_WITH_STATION_EXCEPTION | SENSOR_ANOMALY | UNCERTAIN")
+    regional_score: float | None = None
+    health_score: float | None = None
+    health_status: str | None = None
+    estimated_temperature_c: float | None = None
+    estimated_pressure_hpa: float | None = None
+    estimated_relative_humidity_pct: float | None = None
+    replacement_recommended: bool | None = None
+    explanation: dict[str, Any] | None = None
+    gap_event: dict[str, Any] | None = None
+    processing_latency_ms: float | None = Field(None, description="engine time per observation (amortised over batch_size)")
+    batch_size: int | None = None
+    edge_flags: list[str] | None = None
+    edge_health_score: float | None = None
+
+
+class IngestResponse(BaseModel):
+    accepted: int
+    duplicates: int
+    rejected: int
+    results: list[ObservationResult]
+
+
+class StationOut(BaseModel):
+    station_id: str
+    latitude: float | None = None
+    longitude: float | None = None
+    altitude_m: float | None = None
+    source: str | None = None
+    status: str
+    label: str
+    online: bool
+    last_observation_time: str | None = None
+    health_score: float | None = None
+    health_status: str | None = None
+    health_reasons: list[str] = []
+    maintenance: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    neighbors: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    active_anomalies: int = 0
+    active_critical: int = 0
+
+
+class AnomalyOut(BaseModel):
+    id: int
+    observation_id: int | None
+    station_id: str
+    observation_time: str
+    detected_at: str
+    parameter: str | None
+    fault_pattern: str
+    severity: str | None
+    anomaly_probability: float | None
+    anomaly_score: float | None
+    raw_value: float | None
+    estimated_value: float | None
+    regional_evidence: bool
+    explanation: dict[str, Any] | None
+    state: str
+    detector_mode: str | None
+
+
+class AnomalyUpdate(BaseModel):
+    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
+    state: Annotated[str, Field(pattern="^(OPEN|ACKNOWLEDGED|FALSE_ALARM|RESOLVED)$")]
+
+
+class ReplayStart(BaseModel):
+    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
+    scenario: Annotated[str, Field(pattern=r"^[a-z0-9_]{1,64}$")] = "sih_demo"
+    speed: Annotated[float, Field(gt=0, le=1e7)] = 7200.0
+    reset: bool = True
+
+
+class HealthOut(BaseModel):
+    status: str
+    model_loaded: bool
+    detector_mode: str
+    model_version: str | None
+    database_ok: bool
+    stations: int
+    auth_required_for_writes: bool"},{"sha":"5f1954212df744011b51153f8df1702138e4967e","filename":"config/skyguard.toml","status":"added","additions":95,"deletions":0,"changes":95,"blob_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/blob/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/config%2Fskyguard.toml","raw_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/raw/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/config%2Fskyguard.toml","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/contents/config%2Fskyguard.toml?ref=268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,95 @@
+# SkyGuard AI configuration. Every threshold used by QC, detection, severity,
+# health and maintenance logic lives here and is versioned with `config_version`.
+config_version = "1.0.0"
+feature_version = "fv2"   # fv2: robust neighbour median (outlier exclusion) + decision-rule context
+
+[data]
+start = "2023-01-01"
+end = "2025-01-01"          # exclusive
+interval_minutes = 60       # canonical hourly grid (many Indian aerodromes report hourly)
+max_interpolate_slots = 2   # real gaps <= this many slots are interpolated (flagged 'interpolated')
+# Stations to fetch. Roles are assigned in [split]; nothing else in the code names a station.
+stations = [
+  { id = "VIDP" }, { id = "VIDD" }, { id = "VIAG" }, { id = "VIJP" }, { id = "VIDN" }, { id = "VICG" },
+  { id = "VIGR" }, { id = "VILK" }, { id = "VIAR" }, { id = "VILH" },
+  { id = "VABB" }, { id = "VAJJ" }, { id = "VAPO" }, { id = "VAAU" }, { id = "VAAH" }, { id = "VAID" },
+  { id = "VABP" }, { id = "VANP" },
+  { id = "VOBL" }, { id = "VOBG" }, { id = "VOMY" }, { id = "VOCB" }, { id = "VOMM" }, { id = "VOTV" },
+  { id = "VOCI" }, { id = "VOCL" }, { id = "VOML" }, { id = "VOHS" }, { id = "VOHY" }, { id = "VOTR" },
+  { id = "VOMD" }, { id = "VOPB" },
+  { id = "VECC" }, { id = "VEBS" },
+]
+
+[split]
+# Time-aware + station-aware split. Held-out stations never appear in train or
+# validation, not even as spatial neighbours.
+train_end = "2024-01-01"
+val_end = "2024-07-01"
+holdout_stations = ["VOBG", "VOTV", "VIJP", "VOPB"]
+min_completeness = 0.6      # stations below this fraction of valid slots are dropped (recorded)
+
+[injection]
+# Separate magnitude/duration profiles so the final test does not reuse the
+# training injection pattern. Seeds are also disjoint.
+train_seed = 11
+val_seed = 21
+test_seed = 9001            # v1 frozen final benchmark (evaluated once; historical)
+test_seed_v2 = 9002         # v2 frozen final benchmark: frozen BEFORE the hardening pass, evaluated once afterwards
+events_per_station_month = 4
+warmup_days = 8             # clean history prepended to val/test so past-only features are defined
+# injected values are quantised to the source resolution (METAR: whole degC) so no precision shortcut exists
+resolution = { temperature_c = 1.0, pressure_hpa = 0.338639, relative_humidity_pct = 0.1 }  # P: 0.01 inHg altimeter step
+
+[qc]
+temperature_c = { min = -60.0, max = 60.0, max_step = 12.0 }
+pressure_hpa = { min = 850.0, max = 1090.0, max_step = 8.0 }
+relative_humidity_pct = { min = 0.0, max = 100.0, max_step = 60.0 }
+sentinels = [-9999.0, -999.0, -99.9, 9999.0, 999.9, 99999.0]
+future_tolerance_minutes = 10
+flatline_slots = 8              # identical values across all three variables for this many slots (hours)
+abnormal_gap_minutes = 90
+delayed_minutes = 60            # ingestion - observation > this => delayed (NOT an anomaly)
+
+[features]
+short_window = "4h"
+long_window = "24h"
+seasonal_window = "7D"
+min_periods = 3
+neighbor_radius_km = 300.0
+neighbor_max = 6
+neighbor_time_tolerance_minutes = 45
+persistence_window = "4h"     # DRIFT/STEP need one-signed deviation sustained over this window
+
+[model]
+seed = 7
+max_false_alerts_per_station_day = 0.2   # operating-point budget used when choosing thresholds on validation
+max_regional_event_alert_share = 0.10  # pre-registered: <= 10% of regional weather events may raise any alert (validation)
+regional_fraction = 0.6         # >= this share of neighbours moving together => regional evidence
+regional_suppression = 0.35     # probability multiplier for weather-plausible regional events
+
+[severity]
+# score = 40*p + 20*min(|z|/10,1) + 15*min(persist/6,1) + 10*(n_vars-1)/2 + 10*isolation + 5*qc_hard
+weights = { probability = 40, magnitude = 20, persistence = 15, variables = 10, isolation = 10, qc = 5 }
+thresholds = { MEDIUM = 45, HIGH = 65, CRITICAL = 82 }
+
+[health]
+window = "24h"
+# penalties are points per unit rate (0..1) within the window
+anomaly_rate = 60
+missing_rate = 40
+flatline_rate = 40
+drift = 15
+comm_gaps = 20
+status = { NORMAL = 85, WATCH = 70, DEGRADED = 50 }
+
+[maintenance]
+min_history_days = 3
+recent_days = 7
+
+[realtime]
+offline_after_minutes = 120
+buffer_rows = 400
+
+[api]
+max_batch = 5000
+max_body_bytes = 2_000_000"},{"sha":"614a4a38466f7cc41597aae814aa78b1e100cded","filename":"dashboard/index.html","status":"added","additions":13,"deletions":0,"changes":13,"blob_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/blob/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/dashboard%2Findex.html","raw_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/raw/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/dashboard%2Findex.html","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/contents/dashboard%2Findex.html?ref=268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@

+// Thin API client. Demo deployment has authentication disabled.
+const BASE = "/api/v1";
+
+async function req(path, opts = {}) {
+  const headers = { "Content-Type": "application/json" };
+  const r = await fetch(BASE + path, { ...opts, headers });
+  if (!r.ok) {
+    let detail = r.statusText;
+    try { detail = (await r.json()).detail || detail; } catch { /* non-JSON error */ }
+    throw new Error(`${r.status}: ${typeof detail === "string" ? detail : JSON.stringify(detail)}`);
+  }
+  return r.json();
+}
+
+export const api = {
+  health: () => req("/health"),
+  stations: () => req("/stations"),
+  anomalies: (q = "") => req(`/anomalies?limit=300${q}`),
+  history: (sid, limit = 240) => req(`/observations/history?station_id=${encodeURIComponent(sid)}&limit=${limit}`),
+  metrics: () => req("/metrics"),
+  scenarios: () => req("/replay/scenarios"),
+  replayStatus: () => req("/replay/status"),
+  replayStart: (scenario, speed) => req("/replay/start", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ scenario, speed, reset: true }) }),
+  replayStop: () => req("/replay/stop", { method: "POST", body: "{}" }),
+  review: (id, state) => req(`/anomalies/${id}`, { method: "PATCH", body: JSON.stringify({ state }) }),
+};
+
+// Server-Sent Events with automatic reconnect (EventSource retries on its own).
+export function subscribe(handlers, onState) {
+  const es = new EventSource(BASE + "/stream");
+  es.onopen = () => onState("live");
+  es.onerror = () => onState("reconnecting");
+  for (const [ev, fn] of Object.entries(handlers)) es.addEventListener(ev, (e) => fn(JSON.parse(e.data)));
+  return () => es.close();
+}"},{"sha":"358ef1823f7e5592398ae490a28a8e503a866b7b","filename":"dashboard/src/components.jsx","status":"added","additions":246,"deletions":0,"changes":246,"blob_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/blob/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/dashboard%2Fsrc%2Fcomponents.jsx","raw_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/raw/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/dashboard%2Fsrc%2Fcomponents.jsx","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/contents/dashboard%2Fsrc%2Fcomponents.jsx?ref=268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,246 @@
+import { useMemo, useState } from "react";

+export const STATUS = {

+  { k: "relative_humidity_pct", label: "Relative humidity", unit: "%" },
+];
+const VLABEL = Object.fromEntries(VARS.map((v) => [v.k, v.label]));
+export const PATTERN = {
+  SPIKE: "Spike", NEGATIVE_SPIKE: "Negative spike", FLATLINE: "Flatline / frozen", DRIFT: "Gradual drift",
+  STEP_OFFSET: "Step / offset", MISSING_COMMUNICATION: "Missing / comm. gap", SENTINEL_CORRUPTION: "Corrupt value",
+  MULTIVARIATE_INCONSISTENCY: "Multivariate inconsistency", SPATIAL_INCONSISTENCY: "Spatial inconsistency",
+  COMPOSITE_FAULT: "Composite fault", UNKNOWN_SUSPECT: "Unclassified suspect", REGIONAL_WEATHER_EVENT: "Regional weather event",
+};
+
+const WVS = {
+  NORMAL: "normal weather", REGIONAL_WEATHER: "regional weather (not a sensor fault)",
+  REGIONAL_WEATHER_WITH_STATION_EXCEPTION: "regional weather, but this station shows its own anomaly",

+export function LineChart({ rows, v, label, unit, onPick }) {
+  const [hover, setHover] = useState(null);
+  const W = 720, H = 170, L = 52, R = 12, T = 14, B = 24;
+  const pts = useMemo(() => rows.map((r) => ({

+  const good = pts.filter((p) => p.y != null && !p.corrupt).map((p) => p.y).concat(pts.filter((p) => p.est != null).map((p) => p.est));
+  let lo = Math.min(...good), hi = Math.max(...good);
+  if (!Number.isFinite(lo)) { lo = 0; hi = 1; }
+  if (hi - lo < 1) { lo -= 0.5; hi += 0.5; }
+  const pad = (hi - lo) * 0.08;
+  lo -= pad; hi += pad;
+  const t0 = pts[0].t, t1 = Math.max(pts[pts.length - 1].t, t0 + 1);
+  const X = (t) => L + ((t - t0) / (t1 - t0)) * (W - L - R);
+  const Y = (val) => T + (1 - (Math.min(Math.max(val, lo), hi) - lo) / (hi - lo)) * (H - T - B);

+  }

+    const box = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();

+    let best = 0;
+    pts.forEach((p, i) => { if (Math.abs(p.t - tx) < Math.abs(pts[best].t - tx)) best = i; });

+  };
+  const hp = hover != null ? pts[hover] : null;
+  return (
+    <div className="chart">
+      <div className="chart-title">{label} <span className="muted">({unit})</span></div>
+      <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`} onMouseMove={move} onMouseLeave={() => setHover(null)}
+        onClick={() => hp && hp.row.is_anomaly && onPick && onPick(hp.row)} role="img" aria-label={`${label} time series`}>
+        {[lo, (lo + hi) / 2, hi].map((g, i) => (
+          <g key={i}><line x1={L} x2={W - R} y1={Y(g)} y2={Y(g)} className="grid" /><text x={L - 6} y={Y(g) + 4} className="axis" textAnchor="end">{g.toFixed(1)}</text></g>
+        ))}
+        <text x={L} y={H - 6} className="axis">{fmtTime(pts[0].row.observation_time)}</text>
+        <text x={W - R} y={H - 6} className="axis" textAnchor="end">{fmtTime(pts[pts.length - 1].row.observation_time)}</text>
+        <path d={d} className="series" />
+        {pts.map((p, i) => p.row.regional_suppressed && (
+          <path key={`r${i}`} d={`M${X(p.t)},${T} l-5,-8 h10z`} transform={`translate(0,8)`} fill="var(--blue)"><title>Regional weather event evidence</title></path>
+        ))}
+        {pts.map((p, i) => affects(p.row, v) && p.est != null && p.y != null && !p.corrupt && (
+          <line key={`e${i}`} x1={X(p.t)} x2={X(p.t)} y1={Y(p.y)} y2={Y(p.est)} className="est-link" />
+        ))}
+        {pts.map((p, i) => affects(p.row, v) && p.est != null && (
+          <rect key={`d${i}`} x={X(p.t) - 4} y={Y(p.est) - 4} width={8} height={8} transform={`rotate(45 ${X(p.t)} ${Y(p.est)})`} className="est-pt" />
+        ))}
+        {pts.map((p, i) => affects(p.row, v) && (
+          <circle key={`a${i}`} cx={X(p.t)} cy={p.corrupt || p.y == null ? H - B - 3 : Y(p.y)} r={4.5}
+            fill={SEV[p.row.severity] || "var(--red)"} stroke="var(--bg)" strokeWidth={1.5} />
+        ))}
+        {hp && <line x1={X(hp.t)} x2={X(hp.t)} y1={T} y2={H - B} className="cursor" />}
+      </svg>
+      {hp && (
+        <div className="tip">
+          <b>{fmtTime(hp.row.observation_time)}</b> raw {hp.y == null ? "missing" : `${num(hp.y)} ${unit}`}
+          {affects(hp.row, v) && <> · <span style={{ color: SEV[hp.row.severity] }}>{PATTERN[hp.row.fault_pattern] || hp.row.fault_pattern}</span>

+      )}

+# SkyGuard AI - Final SIH Evaluation Report
+
+_Generated by `scripts/make_report.py` from `artifacts/` (final evaluation run 2026-09-29T07:12:36+00:00). Every number is read from the evaluation artifacts._
+
+## 1. Executive summary
+
+SkyGuard AI is a **production-oriented SIH prototype**: an observation-quality layer for Automatic Weather Station temperature, pressure and relative humidity. It is not production infrastructure (see Limitations).
+
+On the **v2 frozen final benchmark** (94,367 hourly observations; 22 Indian stations including 4 held-out stations; unseen seed 9002; unseen injection profile; frozen 2026-09-29T06:16:12+00:00 before this hardening pass) the selected SkyGuard Hybrid achieved:
+
+* precision 0.820, row-level recall 0.457, F1 0.587, PR-AUC 0.688, ROC-AUC 0.903;
+* 0.184 false alerts per station-day; event-level recall 90.1%;
+* regional weather events with any alert: **13.4%** (same model without the weather-vs-sensor decision rules on the same data: 43.3%);
+* held-out stations F1 0.577 vs seen stations 0.589;
+* SIH scenarios: 11/11 passed; Docker: **ENVIRONMENT-UNVERIFIED** - No Docker engine is installed on the verification machine; build/startup/health/smoke were NOT run.
+
+## 2. Dataset provenance
+
+* Observations come from the **Iowa Environmental Mesonet (IEM) archive** (https://mesonet.agron.iastate.edu/cgi-bin/request/asos.py), network IN__ASOS.
+* They originate from **Indian aerodrome METAR/SPECI reports** (India Meteorological Department (IMD) aerodrome meteorological offices (METAR/SPECI reports exchanged via WMO GTS)).
+* This is **not the IMD AWS network feed**. It is used as an Indian AWS-like observation stream / proxy benchmark; results must not be read as performance on the IMD AWS network. Real AWS data, if obtained, would be a separately documented dataset with its own provenance and evaluation.
+* 22 stations kept on an hourly grid; 12 excluded for completeness (recorded in `data/processed/stations.json`). Raw files are stored exactly as received with SHA-256 in `data/raw/iem_metar/PROVENANCE.json` and are never modified.
+* Temperature resolution is 1 °C; pressure is the METAR altimeter setting (QNH).
+
+## 3. Evaluation protocol and model-selection integrity
+
+| Split | Period | Stations | Seed | Profile | Use |
+|---|---|---|---:|---|---|
+| train | 2023-01-01 to 2024-01-01 | 18 | 11 | train | model fitting only |
+| val | 2024-01-01 to 2024-07-01 | 18 | 21 | val | model, threshold, calibration, rule and operating-point selection |
+| final_eval | 2024-07-01 to 2024-12-31 | 22 | 9001 | test | v1 frozen final test (evaluated once in the first pass; historical) |
+| final_eval_v2 | 2024-07-01 to 2024-12-31 | 22 | 9002 | test | v2 frozen final test (frozen before this pass; evaluated once, now) |
+
+* Held-out stations (never in train/validation, not even as neighbours): VOBG, VOTV, VIJP, VOPB.
+* v2 benchmark SHA-256 `7ac4977808eeaf0c2be8004b6f0df41a3ab484da1601be68eafff5f958adc5d3`, frozen 2026-09-29T06:16:12+00:00; model trained 2026-09-29T06:58:05+00:00; integrity verified at evaluation: True. `run_log.jsonl` records every final-evaluation run.
+* **Selection happened on validation.** The variant, decision rules and threshold were chosen with the pre-registered criterion: validation: false alerts/station-day <= budget and regional-event alert share <= budget; maximise event recall, then F1. The final-test data remained held out; the final-test comparison of variants below is a retrospective evaluation only. Choosing the variant from final-test numbers (even where another variant scores slightly higher there) would leak the test set into the model and was deliberately not done.
+* The v1 aggregate results motivated this hardening pass (clean-station false DRIFT, regional false alerts). All design and selection work in this pass used validation data, regression tests and the SIH demo replay (integration/UX only); the v2 benchmark with a new unseen seed was frozen before any change and evaluated once at the end.
+* Scenario G was re-defined during this pass: it previously compared *raw detector probabilities* of the isolated event and the regional event; it now checks the system's decision (isolated change -> SPATIAL_INCONSISTENCY sensor alert with status SENSOR_ANOMALY while the regional event raises no sensor-fault alert). The raw probabilities are still reported in the scenario evidence, and the regional rows' raw probability exceeds the isolated one's.
+* The validation false-alert budget was reused by the new rules: total validation false alerts stay at the budget while their composition shifts away from DRIFT/STEP and regional-event rows (see the Weather-vs-Sensor analysis).
+
+## 4. Models and decision layer
+
+Baselines: fixed thresholds; rolling robust z-score; Isolation Forest; MLP temporal autoencoder. Final: SkyGuard Hybrid, variant `full` (gradient-boosted detector + isotonic calibration + fault-pattern and parameter classifiers), alert threshold 0.23, followed by the validated weather-vs-sensor decision layer `{"confirm_persistent": true, "k6": 1.5, "c3": 0.5, "max_shared": 0.5, "regional_suppress": true, "regional_min": 0.5}`: persistence-aware DRIFT/STEP confirmation and regional-evidence suppression that never suppresses a station exception or a deterministic-QC fault.

+## 7. Final metrics (v2)
+
+* Detection: precision 0.820, recall 0.457, F1 0.587, ROC-AUC 0.903, PR-AUC 0.688.
+* False alarms: FPR 0.0085, 7.85 per 1000 observations, 0.184 per station-day (4022 station-days).
+* Row-level recall 0.457; event-level recall 90.1% over 503 injected events.
+
+> Row-level recall measures individual anomalous observations that were correctly flagged. Event-level recall measures whether an injected anomaly event was detected at least once. A single event can therefore have high event recall while containing missed anomalous rows.
+
+* Fault classification: macro-F1 0.562 (incl. NORMAL), 0.521 (anomaly classes); parameter attribution accuracy 95.1%.

+# SkyGuard AI - Weather-vs-Sensor Analysis
+
+_Generated from `artifacts/` (2026-09-29T07:12:36+00:00)._

+## Objective
+
+Distinguish genuine regional weather (neighbours change together, T/P/RH physically consistent) from isolated sensor/data faults - including a faulty station *during* a regional event - without hiding true faults.
+
+## Method
+
+1. **Regional evidence score** (0-1): for every strongly deviating parameter, the share of valid neighbours showing a similar change within +/-1 observation interval (temporal alignment), weighted by neighbour coverage (3+ neighbours = full weight). Neighbours that deviate from the rest of the neighbourhood (e.g. a drifting neighbour) are excluded first (robust median).
+2. **Station exception**: while the regional score is high, a parameter that deviates strongly but is *not* shared, an inconsistent temperature/humidity relationship, or a deterministic-QC violation marks the station as an exception.
+3. **Weather status** per observation: NORMAL, REGIONAL_WEATHER, REGIONAL_WEATHER_WITH_STATION_EXCEPTION, SENSOR_ANOMALY, UNCERTAIN.
+4. **Decision rules** (validated): DRIFT/STEP alerts require sustained, one-signed, station-specific deviation; an alert whose evidence is regional and has no station exception is not raised as a sensor fault (logged as INFO). A station exception or deterministic-QC fault is never suppressed.
+5. Parameters selected on validation: `{"confirm_persistent": true, "k6": 1.5, "c3": 0.5, "max_shared": 0.5, "regional_suppress": true, "regional_min": 0.5}`, threshold 0.23.

+"""Build the edge C library and measure what is measurable without ESP32 hardware.
+
+Produces:
+  edge/build/skyguard_edge.(dll|so)  host shared library (used by the station simulator via ctypes)
+  edge/build/edge_bench(.exe)        host benchmark harness
+  edge/build/skyguard_edge_rv32.o    cross-compiled object for RV32IMC (ESP32-C3 core ISA)
+  artifacts/edge/edge_metrics.json   measured sizes / host timings (no energy numbers: not measured)
+
+Compiler: zig cc (pip package `ziglang`), i.e. clang/LLVM.
+"""
+import json
+import re
+import struct
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+FW = ROOT / "edge" / "firmware"
+BUILD = ROOT / "edge" / "build"
+OUT = ROOT / "artifacts" / "edge"
+ZIG = [sys.executable, "-m", "ziglang", "cc"]
+RV = ["-target", "riscv32-linux-musl", "-mcpu=generic_rv32+m+c", "-Os", "-ffunction-sections", "-fdata-sections"]
+
+
+def run(args: list[str], **kw) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
+    return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, **kw)
+
+
+def elf32_sections(path: Path) -> dict:
+    """Sum allocated section sizes of an ELF32 little-endian relocatable object."""
+    b = path.read_bytes()
+    assert b[:4] == b"\x7fELF" and b[4] == 1, "expected ELF32"
+    e_shoff, = struct.unpack_from("<I", b, 0x20)
+    e_shentsize, e_shnum, e_shstrndx = struct.unpack_from("<HHH", b, 0x2E)
+    hdrs = [struct.unpack_from("<IIIIIIIIII", b, e_shoff + i * e_shentsize) for i in range(e_shnum)]
+    strtab_off = hdrs[e_shstrndx][4]
+    out = {"text": 0, "rodata": 0, "data": 0, "bss": 0, "sections": {}}
+    for name_off, typ, flags, _, _, size, *_ in hdrs:
+        name = b[strtab_off + name_off: b.index(b"\0", strtab_off + name_off)].decode()
+        if not flags & 0x2:  # SHF_ALLOC
+            continue
+        out["sections"][name] = size
+        if flags & 0x4:
+            out["text"] += size
+        elif typ == 8:
+            out["bss"] += size
+        elif flags & 0x1:
+            out["data"] += size
+        else:
+            out["rodata"] += size
+    return out
+
+
+def stack_frames(asm: str) -> dict:
+    frames, fn = {}, None
+    for line in asm.splitlines():
+        m = re.match(r"^([A-Za-z_]\w*):", line)
+        if m:
+            fn = m.group(1)
+        m = re.search(r"addi\s+sp,\s*sp,\s*-(\d+)", line)
+        if m and fn and fn not in frames:
+            frames[fn] = int(m.group(1))
+    return frames
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    BUILD.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    src = str(FW / "skyguard_edge.c")
+    lib = BUILD / ("skyguard_edge.dll" if sys.platform == "win32" else "libskyguard_edge.so")
+    exe = BUILD / ("edge_bench.exe" if sys.platform == "win32" else "edge_bench")
+    run(ZIG + ["-O2", "-shared", "-fPIC", "-o", str(lib), src])
+    run(ZIG + ["-O2", "-o", str(exe), str(FW / "bench_host.c"), src])
+    obj = BUILD / "skyguard_edge_rv32.o"
+    run(ZIG + RV + ["-c", "-o", str(obj), src])
+    asm_path = BUILD / "skyguard_edge_rv32.s"
+    run(ZIG + RV + ["-S", "-o", str(asm_path), src])
+    asm = asm_path.read_text()
+    sizes = elf32_sections(obj)
+    frames = stack_frames(asm)

+    r = run([str(exe)], input=lines)
+    bench = json.loads(r.stderr.strip().splitlines()[-1])
+    flags = np.array([int(x.split(",")[0]) for x in r.stdout.split()])

+        "implementation": "Portable C99 library edge/firmware/skyguard_edge.c (same source as the ESP32 sketch)",
+        "hardware_tested": False,
+        "note": "No ESP32 hardware was available. Flash/RAM are measured from the RV32IMC (ESP32-C3 ISA) "
+                "cross-compiled object; runtime is measured on the host CPU. Energy/power was NOT measured.",
+        "flash_bytes_rv32imc_object": {"text": sizes["text"], "rodata": sizes["rodata"], "data": sizes["data"],
+                                        "total": sizes["text"] + sizes["rodata"] + sizes["data"],
+                                        "excludes": "libm logf and soft-float runtime helpers (resolved at link time on target)"},
+        "ram_bytes": {"state_per_station": bench["state_bytes"], "config": bench["config_bytes"], "static_bss": sizes["bss"],
+                      "stack_worst_case_rv32": frames.get("sg_edge_check", 0) + frames.get("dewpoint", 0),
+                      "stack_frames_rv32": frames, "stack_note": "sg_edge_check -> dewpoint call chain; excludes libm logf"},
+        "host_runtime": {"ns_per_observation": bench["ns_per_observation"], "observations": bench["observations"],
+                         "repetitions": bench["repetitions"], "cpu": "host PC (x86-64), clang -O2"},
+        "flag_rate_on_sample": float((flags > 0).mean()),
+        "budget": {"flash_bytes": 8192, "ram_bytes": 1024, "host_ns_per_observation": 10000},
+        "compiler": "zig cc (ziglang PyPI package, clang/LLVM)",

+                                    and bench["state_bytes"] + bench["config_bytes"] + metrics["ram_bytes"]["stack_worst_case_rv32"] <= b["ram_bytes"]
+                                    and bench["ns_per_observation"] <= b["host_ns_per_observation"])
+    (OUT / "edge_metrics.json").write_text(json.dumps(metrics, indent=2))

+    _fields_ = [("last", ctypes.c_float * 3), ("flat_run", ctypes.c_uint16 * 3), ("history", ctypes.c_uint32),
+                ("has_last", ctypes.c_uint8)]
+
+
+def decode(mask: int) -> list[str]:
+    out = [f"{SHORT[v]}_{KIND[k]}" for v in range(3) for k in range(4) if mask & (1 << (4 * v + k))]
+    if mask & (1 << 12):
+        out.append("T_RH_INCONSISTENT")
+    return out
+
+
+class EdgeChecker:
+    """Stateful per-station edge checker. Raises FileNotFoundError if the C library was not built."""
+
+    def __init__(self, lib_path: Path = LIB):
+        if not Path(lib_path).exists():
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"edge library not built: {lib_path} (run python edge/build_edge.py)")
+        self.lib = ctypes.CDLL(str(lib_path))
+        self.lib.sg_edge_check.restype = ctypes.c_uint32
+        self.lib.sg_edge_state_size.restype = ctypes.c_size_t
+        assert self.lib.sg_edge_state_size() == ctypes.sizeof(_State), "C/Python state layout mismatch"
+        self.cfg, self.state = _Cfg(), _State()
+        self.lib.sg_edge_default_config(ctypes.byref(self.cfg))
+        self.lib.sg_edge_init(ctypes.byref(self.state))
+
+    def check(self, obs: dict) -> dict:
+        vals = [obs.get(v) for v in VARS]
+        present = (ctypes.c_uint8 * 3)(*[int(x is not None and math.isfinite(float(x))) for x in vals])
+        x = (ctypes.c_float * 3)(*[float(v) if p else 0.0 for v, p in zip(vals, present)])
+        h = ctypes.c_uint8()
+        mask = self.lib.sg_edge_check(ctypes.byref(self.state), ctypes.byref(self.cfg), x, present, ctypes.byref(h))
+        return {"edge_flags": decode(mask), "edge_health_score": float(h.value)}"},{"sha":"30743f4503376dbcf704ad671096d18a3d117728","filename":"edge/firmware/bench_host.c","status":"added","additions":48,"deletions":0,"changes":48,"blob_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/blob/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/edge%2Ffirmware%2Fbench_host.c","raw_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/raw/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/edge%2Ffirmware%2Fbench_host.c","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/contents/edge%2Ffirmware%2Fbench_host.c?ref=268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+/* Host harness: reads "t,p,rh" lines (empty field = missing) from stdin, runs sg_edge_check on
+ * each, prints "flags,health" per line to stdout and timing to stderr.
+ * Timing is measured on the HOST CPU, not on an ESP32. */
+#include <stdio.h>
+#include <stdlib.h>
+#include <string.h>
+#include <time.h>
+#include "skyguard_edge.h"
+
+#define MAXN 200000
+
+static float vals[MAXN][SG_NVARS];
+static uint8_t pres[MAXN][SG_NVARS];
+static uint32_t flags[MAXN];
+static uint8_t health[MAXN];
+
+int main(void) {
+    char line[256];
+    int n = 0;
+    while (n < MAXN && fgets(line, sizeof line, stdin)) {
+        char *p = line;
+        for (int v = 0; v < SG_NVARS; v++) {
+            char *end;
+            float x = strtof(p, &end);
+            pres[n][v] = (end != p);
+            vals[n][v] = pres[n][v] ? x : 0.0f;
+            p = strchr(end, ',');
+            p = p ? p + 1 : end;
+        }
+        n++;
+    }
+    sg_edge_config_t cfg;
+    sg_edge_default_config(&cfg);
+    sg_edge_state_t st;
+    struct timespec a, b;
+    const int reps = 20;
+    timespec_get(&a, TIME_UTC);
+    for (int r = 0; r < reps; r++) {
+        sg_edge_init(&st);
+        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) flags[i] = sg_edge_check(&st, &cfg, vals[i], pres[i], &health[i]);
+    }
+    timespec_get(&b, TIME_UTC);
+    double ns = ((double)(b.tv_sec - a.tv_sec) * 1e9 + (double)(b.tv_nsec - a.tv_nsec)) / ((double)n * reps);
+    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) printf("%u,%u\n", flags[i], health[i]);
+    fprintf(stderr, "{\"observations\": %d, \"repetitions\": %d, \"ns_per_observation\": %.2f, "
+                    "\"state_bytes\": %zu, \"config_bytes\": %zu}\n", n, reps, ns, sg_edge_state_size(), sg_edge_config_size());
+    return 0;
+}"},{"sha":"6b617c65c8fad1f6037ff14ab26e40f7b88d3b83","filename":"edge/firmware/esp32/skyguard_edge_esp32.ino","status":"added","additions":35,"deletions":0,"changes":35,"blob_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/blob/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/edge%2Ffirmware%2Fesp32%2Fskyguard_edge_esp32.ino","raw_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/raw/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/edge%2Ffirmware%2Fesp32%2Fskyguard_edge_esp32.ino","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/contents/edge%2Ffirmware%2Fesp32%2Fskyguard_edge_esp32.ino?ref=268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@

+// ESP32 hardware in this prototype. Copy skyguard_edge.c/.h next to this sketch.
+// read_sensor() is a placeholder for the station's T/P/RH driver (e.g. a BME280).
+#include "skyguard_edge.h"
+
+static sg_edge_config_t cfg;
+static sg_edge_state_t st;
+
+static bool read_sensor(float out[SG_NVARS]) {
+  // TODO(station integrator): replace with the real sensor driver.
+  out[0] = 25.0f; out[1] = 1008.0f; out[2] = 60.0f;
+  return true;
+}
+
+void setup() {
+  Serial.begin(115200);
+  sg_edge_default_config(&cfg);
+  sg_edge_init(&st);
+}
+
+void loop() {
+  float x[SG_NVARS];

+  uint32_t flags = sg_edge_check(&st, &cfg, x, present, &health);

+  // Payload for the store-and-forward uplink (see edge/station_client.py for buffering semantics).
+  Serial.printf("{\"temperature_c\":%.2f,\"pressure_hpa\":%.2f,\"relative_humidity_pct\":%.2f,"
+                "\"edge_flags_mask\":%lu,\"edge_health_score\":%u,\"edge_us\":%lu}\n",
+                x[0], x[1], x[2], (unsigned long)flags, health, (unsigned long)dt);
+  delay(60000);
+}"},{"sha":"b7d7ee3fdd714491abd87959e9273e86df255086","filename":"edge/firmware/skyguard_edge.c","status":"added","additions":62,"deletions":0,"changes":62,"blob_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/blob/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/edge%2Ffirmware%2Fskyguard_edge.c","raw_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/raw/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/edge%2Ffirmware%2Fskyguard_edge.c","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/contents/edge%2Ffirmware%2Fskyguard_edge.c?ref=268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+#include "skyguard_edge.h"
+#include <math.h>
+
+void sg_edge_default_config(sg_edge_config_t *c) {
+    const float mn[SG_NVARS] = {-60.0f, 850.0f, 0.0f}, mx[SG_NVARS] = {60.0f, 1090.0f, 100.0f};
+    const float step[SG_NVARS] = {6.0f, 4.0f, 30.0f};
+    for (int v = 0; v < SG_NVARS; v++) { c->min[v] = mn[v]; c->max[v] = mx[v]; c->max_step[v] = step[v]; }
+    c->flat_n = 8;
+    c->mv_dt_min = 4.0f;
+    c->mv_drh_max = 0.5f;
+    c->mv_dtd_max = 8.0f;
+}
+
+void sg_edge_init(sg_edge_state_t *st) {
+    for (int v = 0; v < SG_NVARS; v++) { st->last[v] = 0.0f; st->flat_run[v] = 0; }
+    st->history = 0;
+    st->has_last = 0;
+}
+
+static float dewpoint(float t, float rh) {
+    if (rh < 1.0f) rh = 1.0f;
+    float g = logf(rh / 100.0f) + 17.625f * t / (243.04f + t);
+    return 243.04f * g / (17.625f - g);
+}
+
+static uint8_t popcount32(uint32_t x) {
+    uint8_t n = 0;
+    while (x) { x &= x - 1u; n++; }
+    return n;
+}
+
+uint32_t sg_edge_check(sg_edge_state_t *st, const sg_edge_config_t *c, const float x[SG_NVARS],
+                       const uint8_t present[SG_NVARS], uint8_t *health_out) {
+    uint32_t f = 0;
+    uint8_t ok[SG_NVARS];
+    for (int v = 0; v < SG_NVARS; v++) {
+        ok[v] = 0;
+        if (!present[v] || isnan(x[v])) { f |= SG_FLAG(v, SG_MISSING); continue; }
+        if (x[v] < c->min[v] || x[v] > c->max[v]) { f |= SG_FLAG(v, SG_RANGE); continue; } /* includes -9999 etc. */
+        ok[v] = 1;
+        if (st->has_last) {
+            float d = x[v] - st->last[v];
+            if (fabsf(d) > c->max_step[v]) f |= SG_FLAG(v, SG_SPIKE);
+            st->flat_run[v] = (d == 0.0f) ? (uint16_t)(st->flat_run[v] + 1u) : 0u;
+            if (st->flat_run[v] + 1u >= c->flat_n) f |= SG_FLAG(v, SG_FLAT);
+        }
+    }
+    if (st->has_last && ok[0] && ok[2]) {
+        float dt = x[0] - st->last[0], drh = x[2] - st->last[2];
+        float dtd = dewpoint(x[0], x[2]) - dewpoint(st->last[0], st->last[2]);
+        if ((fabsf(dt) >= c->mv_dt_min && fabsf(drh) <= c->mv_drh_max) || fabsf(dtd) >= c->mv_dtd_max)
+            f |= SG_MV_INCONSISTENT;
+    }
+    for (int v = 0; v < SG_NVARS; v++) if (ok[v]) st->last[v] = x[v];
+    st->has_last = (uint8_t)(st->has_last | ok[0] | ok[1] | ok[2]);
+    st->history = (st->history << 1) | (f ? 1u : 0u);
+    if (health_out) *health_out = (uint8_t)(100u - (60u * popcount32(st->history)) / 32u);
+    return f;
+}
+
+size_t sg_edge_state_size(void) { return sizeof(sg_edge_state_t); }
+size_t sg_edge_config_size(void) { return sizeof(sg_edge_config_t); }"},{"sha":"a9300d79d418b1a12bfa593aacff1edcd1de5a61","filename":"edge/firmware/skyguard_edge.h","status":"added","additions":43,"deletions":0,"changes":43,"blob_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/blob/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/edge%2Ffirmware%2Fskyguard_edge.h","raw_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/raw/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/edge%2Ffirmware%2Fskyguard_edge.h","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/contents/edge%2Ffirmware%2Fskyguard_edge.h?ref=268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+/* SkyGuard AI edge checks: lightweight per-observation QC for an ESP32-class AWS logger.
+ * Portable C99, no heap, fixed-size state. The full server model does NOT run here.
+ * Checks: missing, range/sentinel, spike (rate of change), flatline, basic T/RH consistency.
+ */
+#ifndef SKYGUARD_EDGE_H
+#define SKYGUARD_EDGE_H
+#include <stddef.h>
+#include <stdint.h>
+
+#define SG_NVARS 3 /* 0 = temperature_c, 1 = pressure_hpa, 2 = relative_humidity_pct */
+
+/* flag bits: per variable v, bit (4*v + k) with k = 0 missing, 1 range/sentinel, 2 spike, 3 flatline */
+#define SG_MISSING 0u
+#define SG_RANGE 1u
+#define SG_SPIKE 2u
+#define SG_FLAT 3u
+#define SG_FLAG(v, k) (1u << (4u * (v) + (k)))
+#define SG_MV_INCONSISTENT (1u << 12)
+
+typedef struct {
+    float min[SG_NVARS], max[SG_NVARS];
+    float max_step[SG_NVARS];   /* spike threshold: |x - previous| per observation */
+    uint16_t flat_n;            /* identical consecutive values => flatline */
+    float mv_dt_min;            /* T/RH check: |dT| above this ... */
+    float mv_drh_max;           /* ... with |dRH| below this, or */
+    float mv_dtd_max;           /* dew-point jump above this => inconsistent */
+} sg_edge_config_t;
+
+typedef struct {
+    float last[SG_NVARS];
+    uint16_t flat_run[SG_NVARS];
+    uint32_t history;           /* 1 bit per recent observation: flagged or not (last 32) */
+    uint8_t has_last;
+} sg_edge_state_t;
+
+void sg_edge_default_config(sg_edge_config_t *cfg);
+void sg_edge_init(sg_edge_state_t *st);
+/* values: measurements; present[v] = 0 if value v was not received. Returns flag bitmask. */
+uint32_t sg_edge_check(sg_edge_state_t *st, const sg_edge_config_t *cfg, const float values[SG_NVARS],
+                       const uint8_t present[SG_NVARS], uint8_t *health_out);
+size_t sg_edge_state_size(void);
+size_t sg_edge_config_size(void);
+#endif"},{"sha":"abe186038d58027c61079d47b46c8711b7b5c9f8","filename":"edge/station_client.py","status":"added","additions":65,"deletions":0,"changes":65,"blob_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/blob/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/edge%2Fstation_client.py","raw_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/raw/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/edge%2Fstation_client.py","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/contents/edge%2Fstation_client.py?ref=268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@
+"""Remote-station uplink: store-and-forward buffer (offline -> buffer -> reconnect -> upload).
+
+`send(batch)` is any callable that delivers a list of observation dicts and raises on
+failure (HTTP in scripts/replay.py, in-process in the backend replay). Records are removed
+from the buffer only after a successful send, and the server treats duplicates as
+idempotent, so retries never lose or double-count data. The buffer is persisted to a
+JSONL file when `buffer_path` is given, so it also survives a station restart.
+"""
+import json
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+class StationClient:
+    def __init__(self, station_id: str, send: Callable[[list[dict]], object], buffer_path: str | Path | None = None,
+                 max_batch: int = 500, edge=None):
+        self.station_id = station_id
+        self.send = send
+        self.max_batch = max_batch
+        self.edge = edge  # optional edge checker with .check(obs) -> dict (see edge/edge_checks.py)
+        self.online = True
+        self.path = Path(buffer_path) if buffer_path else None
+        self.buffer: list[dict] = []
+        if self.path and self.path.exists():
+            self.buffer = [json.loads(line) for line in self.path.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
+        self.stats = {"observed": 0, "sent": 0, "send_failures": 0, "max_buffered": len(self.buffer), "batches": 0}
+
+    def _persist(self) -> None:
+        if self.path:
+            self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            self.path.write_text("".join(json.dumps(o) + "\n" for o in self.buffer))
+
+    def observe(self, obs: dict) -> None:
+        obs = dict(obs, station_id=self.station_id)
+        if self.edge is not None:
+            obs.update(self.edge.check(obs))
+        self.buffer.append(obs)
+        self.stats["observed"] += 1
+        self.stats["max_buffered"] = max(self.stats["max_buffered"], len(self.buffer))
+        self._persist()
+        if self.online:
+            self.flush()
+
+    def set_link(self, up: bool) -> None:
+        self.online = up
+        if up:
+            self.flush()
+
+    def flush(self) -> int:
+        """Upload buffered records in observation order. Returns records delivered."""
+        sent = 0
+        while self.buffer and self.online:
+            batch = self.buffer[: self.max_batch]
+            try:
+                self.send(batch)
+            except Exception:  # link dropped mid-upload: keep everything, try again later
+                self.stats["send_failures"] += 1
+                self.online = False
+                break
+            del self.buffer[: len(batch)]
+            sent += len(batch)
+            self.stats["sent"] += len(batch)
+            self.stats["batches"] += 1
+            self._persist()
+        return sent"},{"sha":"e69de29bb2d1d6434b8b29ae775ad8c2e48c5391","filename":"injection/__init__.py","status":"added","additions":0,"deletions":0,"changes":0,"blob_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/blob/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/injection%2F__init__.py","raw_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/raw/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/injection%2F__init__.py","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/contents/injection%2F__init__.py?ref=268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145"},{"sha":"98e4a99da7d4e51fc7254097e69e376da9a0b48e","filename":"injection/injector.py","status":"added","additions":305,"deletions":0,"changes":305,"blob_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/blob/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/injection%2Finjector.py","raw_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/raw/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/injection%2Finjector.py","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/contents/injection%2Finjector.py?ref=268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,305 @@
+"""Deterministic anomaly injection engine with preserved ground truth.
+
+Every injected row keeps its original clean values in `clean_<var>` and the
+primary parameter's clean value in `ground_truth_value`. Output depends only on
+(input data, seed, profile).
+
+Injection kinds -> observable fault class (the evaluation target):
+  positive_spike -> SPIKE              negative_spike -> NEGATIVE_SPIKE
+  pressure_spike -> SPIKE/NEGATIVE_SPIKE (by sign)
+  flatline -> FLATLINE                 drift -> DRIFT
+  step -> STEP_OFFSET                  missing_block -> MISSING_COMMUNICATION
+  sentinel -> SENTINEL_CORRUPTION      humidity_corruption -> MULTIVARIATE_INCONSISTENCY
+  multivariate_inconsistency -> MULTIVARIATE_INCONSISTENCY
+  spatial_inconsistency -> SPATIAL_INCONSISTENCY
+  composite -> COMPOSITE_FAULT
+  regional_event -> NORMAL (a plausible weather event across neighbours; must NOT be flagged)
+"""
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+
+from ml.config import load_config
+from ml.features import dewpoint, neighbors, rh_from
+from ml.schema import VARS
+
+KINDS = ["positive_spike", "negative_spike", "pressure_spike", "flatline", "drift", "step", "missing_block",
+         "sentinel", "humidity_corruption", "multivariate_inconsistency", "spatial_inconsistency", "composite"]
+
+# Magnitude / duration profiles (durations in rows of the canonical grid, hourly by default). Train, validation and test differ on purpose.
+PROFILES = {
+    "train": dict(spike_t=(6, 15), spike_rh=(25, 45), spike_p=(4, 10), spike_len=(1, 1),
+                  flat_len=(6, 16), drift_len=(24, 72), drift_t=(3, 7), drift_p=(3, 8), drift_rh=(12, 25),
+                  step_len=(6, 48), step_t=(3, 7), step_p=(3, 8), step_rh=(12, 25), miss_len=(2, 12),
+                  sent_len=(1, 2), hum_len=(2, 6), mv_len=(2, 6), mv_t=(3, 5), mv_rh=(18, 30),
+                  sp_len=(3, 8), sp_t=(4, 7), regional_t=(4, 8), regional_len=(3, 8)),
+    "val": dict(spike_t=(5, 18), spike_rh=(20, 50), spike_p=(3, 12), spike_len=(1, 2),
+                flat_len=(5, 20), drift_len=(18, 96), drift_t=(2.5, 8), drift_p=(2.5, 9), drift_rh=(10, 28),
+                step_len=(4, 60), step_t=(2.5, 8), step_p=(2.5, 9), step_rh=(10, 28), miss_len=(1, 18),
+                sent_len=(1, 3), hum_len=(2, 8), mv_len=(2, 8), mv_t=(2.5, 5.5), mv_rh=(15, 32),
+                sp_len=(2, 10), sp_t=(3.5, 7.5), regional_t=(3.5, 9), regional_len=(2, 10)),
+    "test": dict(spike_t=(4, 25), spike_rh=(18, 60), spike_p=(3, 15), spike_len=(1, 3),
+                 flat_len=(4, 24), drift_len=(12, 120), drift_t=(2, 10), drift_p=(2, 10), drift_rh=(8, 30),
+                 step_len=(3, 72), step_t=(2, 10), step_p=(2, 10), step_rh=(8, 30), miss_len=(1, 24),
+                 sent_len=(1, 4), hum_len=(2, 10), mv_len=(2, 10), mv_t=(2.5, 6), mv_rh=(15, 35),
+                 sp_len=(2, 12), sp_t=(3, 8), regional_t=(3, 10), regional_len=(2, 12)),
+}
+SEASON = {1: "winter", 2: "winter", 3: "pre-monsoon", 4: "pre-monsoon", 5: "pre-monsoon", 6: "monsoon",
+          7: "monsoon", 8: "monsoon", 9: "monsoon", 10: "post-monsoon", 11: "post-monsoon", 12: "post-monsoon"}
+PARAM_KEY = {"temperature_c": "t", "pressure_hpa": "p", "relative_humidity_pct": "rh"}
+
+
+class _Station:
+    def __init__(self, frame: pd.DataFrame):
+        self.idx = frame.index.to_numpy()  # positions in the full frame
+        self.vals = {v: frame[v].to_numpy(dtype=float).copy() for v in VARS}
+        self.busy = np.zeros(len(frame), dtype=bool)
+        self.valid = ~np.isnan(np.column_stack([self.vals[v] for v in VARS])).any(axis=1)
+
+
+def _sev(q: float) -> str:
+    return "LOW" if q < 1 / 3 else "MEDIUM" if q < 2 / 3 else "HIGH"
+
+
+def inject(df: pd.DataFrame, seed: int, profile: str = "train", stations_meta: dict | None = None,
+           cfg: dict | None = None) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
+    """Return (benchmark frame, event log). `df` is a canonical frame on a regular per-station grid."""
+    cfg = cfg or load_config()
+    P = PROFILES[profile]
+    warm = cfg["injection"]["warmup_days"] * 24 * 60 // cfg["data"]["interval_minutes"]  # never inject into warm-up
+    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
+    out = df.sort_values(["station_id", "timestamp"]).reset_index(drop=True).copy()
+    for v in VARS:
+        out[f"clean_{v}"] = out[v]
+    out["is_anomaly"] = 0
+    out["anomaly_type"] = "NORMAL"
+    out["injection_kind"] = ""
+    out["severity"] = ""
+    out["injected_parameter"] = ""
+    out["ground_truth_value"] = np.nan
+    out["injection_id"] = ""
+    # real long gaps in the source data are genuine missing-communication rows (not injected)
+    real_gap = out[VARS].isna().all(axis=1)
+    out.loc[real_gap, ["is_anomaly", "anomaly_type", "injection_id"]] = [1, "MISSING_COMMUNICATION", "REAL_GAP"]
+
+    meta = stations_meta or {s: {"latitude": g["latitude"].iloc[0], "longitude": g["longitude"].iloc[0]}
+                             for s, g in out.groupby("station_id")}
+    nb = neighbors({s: meta[s] for s in out["station_id"].unique()}, cfg)
+    st = {s: _Station(g) for s, g in out.groupby("station_id", sort=True)}
+    events = []
+    counter = [0]
+
+    def label(sid, a, b, kind, cls, param, sev, gt_param):

+        rows = s.idx[a:b]
+        iid = f"s{seed}-{counter[0]:05d}"
+        counter[0] += 1

+            [0 if cls == "NORMAL" else 1, cls, kind, sev, param, iid]
+        if gt_param:
+            out.loc[rows, "ground_truth_value"] = out.loc[rows, f"clean_{gt_param}"].to_numpy()
+        s.busy[max(a - 4, 0): b + 4] = True
+        t0 = out.at[rows[0], "timestamp"]
+        events.append(dict(injection_id=iid, station_id=sid, kind=kind, anomaly_type=cls, parameter=param,
+                           severity=sev, start=t0, end=out.at[rows[-1], "timestamp"], n_rows=len(rows),
+                           season=SEASON[t0.month], seed=seed, profile=profile))

+
+    def pick_window(sid, length, tries=40):

+        n = len(s.idx)
+        for _ in range(tries):

+    def mag(key):

+        m = float(rng.uniform(lo, hi))

+
+    def ilen(key):

+        return int(rng.integers(lo, hi + 1))
+
+    def apply_regional(anchor):

+        for sid in members:

+            j = int(pd.DatetimeIndex(out.loc[s.idx, "timestamp"]).searchsorted(t_start))

+            shape = np.minimum(1.0, (k + 1) / 2.0) * np.clip((b - j - k) / max((b - j) * 0.6, 1), 0, 1)
+            dm = sign * m * float(rng.uniform(0.8, 1.2)) * shape

+            t1 = t0 + dm
+            s.vals["temperature_c"][j:b] = np.round(t1, 1)

+            s.vals["pressure_hpa"][j:b] = np.round(s.vals["pressure_hpa"][j:b] - 0.3 * dm * float(rng.uniform(0.5, 1.0)), 1)

+
+    def apply(sid, kind):
+        s = st[sid]
+        V = s.vals
+        if kind in ("positive_spike", "negative_spike"):
+            L = ilen("spike_len")
+            w = pick_window(sid, L)
+            if not w:
+                return
+            a, b = w
+            param = rng.choice(["temperature_c", "relative_humidity_pct"])
+            sign = 1.0 if kind == "positive_spike" else -1.0
+            if param == "relative_humidity_pct":

+            m, q = mag("spike_t" if param == "temperature_c" else "spike_rh")

+            label(sid, a, b, kind, "DRIFT" if kind == "drift" else "STEP_OFFSET", param, _sev(q), param)
+        elif kind == "missing_block":
+            L = ilen("miss_len")
+            w = pick_window(sid, L)
+            if not w:
+                return
+            a, b = w
+            for p in VARS:
+                V[p][a:b] = np.nan
+            lo, hi = P["miss_len"]
+            label(sid, a, b, kind, "MISSING_COMMUNICATION", "+".join(VARS), _sev((L - lo) / max(hi - lo, 1)), "")
+        elif kind == "sentinel":
+            L = ilen("sent_len")
+            w = pick_window(sid, L)
+            if not w:
+                return
+            a, b = w
+            param = str(rng.choice(VARS))
+            V[param][a:b] = float(rng.choice(cfg["qc"]["sentinels"]))
+            label(sid, a, b, kind, "SENTINEL_CORRUPTION", param, "HIGH", param)
+        elif kind == "humidity_corruption":
+            L = ilen("hum_len")
+            w = pick_window(sid, L)
+            if not w:
+                return
+            a, b = w
+            noise = rng.normal(0, 22, L)
+            noise = np.where(np.abs(noise) < 10, np.sign(noise + 1e-9) * 10, noise)
+            V["relative_humidity_pct"][a:b] = np.round(np.clip(V["relative_humidity_pct"][a:b] + noise, 3, 100), 1)
+            label(sid, a, b, kind, "MULTIVARIATE_INCONSISTENCY", "relative_humidity_pct", "MEDIUM", "relative_humidity_pct")
+        elif kind == "multivariate_inconsistency":

+            if not w:
+                return
+            a, b = w
+            if rng.random() < 0.5:  # temperature rises but RH does not respond (moisture would have to jump)

+            else:  # RH jumps with temperature unchanged

+                sign = 1.0 if V["relative_humidity_pct"][a:b].max() + m <= 100 else -1.0

+            dm = sign * m * np.minimum(1.0, (k + 1) / 3.0)  # smooth onset: no temporal spike
+            t0 = V["temperature_c"][a:b].copy()
+            td0 = dewpoint(pd.Series(t0), pd.Series(V["relative_humidity_pct"][a:b])).to_numpy()
+            V["temperature_c"][a:b] = t0 + dm
+            V["relative_humidity_pct"][a:b] = np.clip(rh_from(pd.Series(t0 + dm), pd.Series(td0)).to_numpy(), 1, 100)
+            label(sid, a, b, kind, "SPATIAL_INCONSISTENCY", "temperature_c", _sev(q), "temperature_c")
+        elif kind == "composite":
+            L = max(ilen("step_len") // 2, 4)
+            w = pick_window(sid, L)
+            if not w:
+                return
+            a, b = w
+            m1, q1 = mag("spike_t")
+            V["temperature_c"][a] += m1  # temperature spike at onset ...
+            m2, q2 = mag("step_p")
+            V["pressure_hpa"][a:b] += (1 if rng.random() < 0.5 else -1) * m2  # ... plus pressure offset
+            params = "temperature_c+pressure_hpa"
+            if rng.random() < 0.5:
+                V["relative_humidity_pct"][a:b] = V["relative_humidity_pct"][a - 1]  # ... plus frozen RH
+                params += "+relative_humidity_pct"
+            label(sid, a, b, kind, "COMPOSITE_FAULT", params, _sev(max(q1, q2)), "pressure_hpa")
+
+    months = max(1, round((out["timestamp"].max() - out["timestamp"].min()).days / 30))
+    n_events = cfg["injection"]["events_per_station_month"] * months
+    order = sorted(st)
+    # regional weather events first (they need free windows on several stations)
+    for sid in order:
+        if len(nb[sid]) >= 2:

+    for sid in order:
+        for kind in rng.choice(KINDS, size=n_events):
+            apply(sid, str(kind))
+
+    res = cfg["injection"]["resolution"]
+    sentinels = np.array(cfg["qc"]["sentinels"], dtype=float)
+    for sid, s in st.items():
+        for v in VARS:
+            x = s.vals[v]
+            orig = out.loc[s.idx, v].to_numpy(dtype=float)
+            changed = ~np.isclose(x, orig, equal_nan=True) & ~np.isin(x, sentinels) & np.isfinite(x)
+            q = np.where(changed, np.round(np.round(x / res[v]) * res[v], 1), x)  # injected cells only
+            out.loc[s.idx, v] = q
+    return out, pd.DataFrame(events)"},{"sha":"e69de29bb2d1d6434b8b29ae775ad8c2e48c5391","filename":"ml/__init__.py","status":"added","additions":0,"deletions":0,"changes":0,"blob_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/blob/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/ml%2F__init__.py","raw_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/raw/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/ml%2F__init__.py","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/contents/ml%2F__init__.py?ref=268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145"},{"sha":"75c0a459d26eacbbde4b904885d9bce080d52450","filename":"ml/benchmarking.py","status":"added","additions":40,"deletions":0,"changes":40,"blob_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/blob/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/ml%2Fbenchmarking.py","raw_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/raw/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/ml%2Fbenchmarking.py","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/contents/ml%2Fbenchmarking.py?ref=268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+"""Score every approach (baselines, ablation variants, final hybrid) on one feature frame."""
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+
+from .evaluation import detection, eval_mask, event_recall
+from .models import SkyGuardHybrid, ae_score, fixed_threshold_score, robust_stat_score
+from .pipeline import ModelBundle
+
+APPROACH_NAMES = {"fixed_threshold": "Fixed Threshold", "robust_statistical": "Robust Statistical",
+                  "isolation_forest": "Isolation Forest", "temporal_autoencoder": "Temporal Autoencoder (MLP)",
+                  "skyguard_hybrid": "SkyGuard Hybrid"}
+
+
+def hybrid_scores(h: SkyGuardHybrid, F: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
+    """Score = calibrated probability; decision = full hybrid decision (threshold + validated decision rules)."""
+    p, _ = h.predict_proba(F)
+    pattern, _, _ = h.classify(F, p)
+    return p, pattern != "NORMAL"
+
+
+def baseline_scores(bundle: ModelBundle, F: pd.DataFrame) -> dict:
+    th = bundle.thresholds
+    out = {"fixed_threshold": (s := fixed_threshold_score(F), s >= 0.5)}
+    s = robust_stat_score(F)
+    out["robust_statistical"] = (s, s >= th["robust_statistical"])
+    s = bundle.iforest.score(F)
+    out["isolation_forest"] = (s, s >= th["isolation_forest"])
+    s = ae_score(F)
+    out["temporal_autoencoder"] = (s, s >= th["temporal_autoencoder"])
+    return out
+
+
+def compare(F: pd.DataFrame, labels: pd.DataFrame, approaches: dict) -> dict:
+    """approaches: name -> (score, pred). Metrics on eval rows only."""
+    m = eval_mask(labels)
+    L = labels[m]
+    res = {}
+    for name, (score, pred) in approaches.items():
+        res[name] = detection(L, np.asarray(pred)[m], np.asarray(score, float)[m]) | event_recall(L, np.asarray(pred)[m])
+    return res"},{"sha":"3c08a8333c694f65e272cbcd67a0eb5673d23c2e","filename":"ml/config.py","status":"added","additions":11,"deletions":0,"changes":11,"blob_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/blob/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/ml%2Fconfig.py","raw_url":"https://github.com/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/raw/268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145/ml%2Fconfig.py","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Aditya-Murugan1/SIH26073/contents/ml%2Fconfig.py?ref=268ef29cca1c596045670454a1b150071777c145","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
